name: hraness-engineering
description: Map, explain, test, document, measure, and refactor code in one repository, with the evidence for each result.

interface.shortDescription: Map, explain, test, and refactor one repository.
interface.longDescription: Eleven skills for work in one repository: map its features, explain current behavior, reconstruct why code looks the way it does, assess a change's impact, compare approaches, build or maintain an app verifier, write tests, investigate performance, update docs, or refactor without changing behavior.
defaultPrompt: Map this repository's user-visible features and where each is tested.
Create a safe verifier for this application.
Assess the blast radius of this proposed change.
